items.title: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰巴士致至少30人死亡，乌东攻击激增
items.original_title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰官员称，俄罗斯对克拉马托尔斯克两辆拥挤车辆发动袭击，造成至少30人死亡。乌方指责俄方以尽可能多杀伤平民为目标，近期针对乌克兰城市的致命攻击明显增加。
items.summary_en: Ukrainian officials say a Russian strike hit two crowded vehicles in the front-line city of Kramatorsk, killing at least 30 people. Kyiv accused Moscow of targeting civilians as deadly attacks on Ukrainian cities surge.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是俄乌战争中又一起造成大量平民伤亡的袭击，加剧了外界对冲突升级和人道局势恶化的担忧。
items.why_it_matters_en: The attack underscores the intensifying civilian toll in the Russia-Ukraine war and raises concerns about further escalation.

items.title: 中国在老挝建设基地以扩展军事影响力
items.original_title: China Expands Its Military Reach by Building a Base in Laos
items.summary_zh: 纽约时报报道，中国在老挝Ban Keun建设新跑道，目前仅供小型飞机使用。邻国正密切关注北京是否会将其扩建以容纳更大飞机。
items.summary_en: The New York Times reports that China has built a new runway in Ban Keun, Laos, currently used only by small jets. Neighboring countries are watching to see if Beijing expands it for larger aircraft.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若该基地可容纳更大军机，将改变东南亚军事平衡并加深对中国地区影响力的担忧。
items.why_it_matters_en: If expanded for larger aircraft, the base could alter Southeast Asia’s military balance and deepen concerns over China’s regional influence.

items.title: CrowdStrike称黑客利用中国开发AI工具攻击韩国银行
items.original_title: Hacker Used Chinese-Developed A.I. Tool to Target South Korean Banks, CrowdStrike Says
items.summary_zh: CrowdStrike表示，一名可能说中文、具有财务动机的黑客利用中国开发的AI工具攻击韩国银行。该网络安全公司未将攻击归因于特定个人或组织。
items.summary_en: CrowdStrike said an attacker likely a Chinese speaker and financially motivated used a Chinese-developed AI tool to target South Korean banks. The cybersecurity firm did not attribute the attacks to a named individual or group.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该事件显示AI工具正被用于金融网络攻击，并可能增加跨境溯源与归因难度。
items.why_it_matters_en: The case highlights how AI tools are being used in financial cyberattacks and may complicate cross-border attribution.

items.title: 报道称OpenAI收入比此前预期少200亿美元
items.original_title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary_zh: TechCrunch报道称，OpenAI的年化收入比此前报道的约700亿美元少约200亿美元。若属实，这将影响市场对AI头部公司增长与估值前景的判断。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch reports that OpenAI’s annualized revenue is about $20 billion less than the previously reported figure of roughly $70 billion. If accurate, it could reshape expectations for the AI leader’s growth and valuation.
items.why_it_matters_zh: OpenAI是AI行业风向标，其收入预期下修可能影响整个AI产业链的投资与支出计划。
items.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI is a bellwether for the AI industry, so a revenue shortfall could affect investment and spending across the AI supply chain.

items.title: 中国拒绝欧盟关于“自愿限制”混合动力汽车出口的请求
items.summary_zh: 中国拒绝欧盟提出的“自愿限制”混合动力汽车出口请求。欧盟委员会正考虑实施临时限制措施，以应对可能引发严重贸易冲突的中国混合动力汽车出口激增。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 中欧在新能源汽车贸易上的摩擦可能升级，影响双方汽车产业和更广泛的经贸关系。

items.title: 胡塞武装袭击沙特机场导致大量航班取消
items.original_title: Houthi Attacks on Saudi Airports Prompt Mass Cancellations
items.summary_zh: 沙特当局称拦截了两枚针对利雅得的导弹，此前一天胡塞武装对沙特机场的袭击造成三人死亡。袭击导致大量航班取消，地区安全风险上升。
items.summary_en: Saudi authorities said they intercepted two missiles targeting Riyadh, a day after Houthi strikes on airports in the kingdom killed three people. The attacks prompted mass flight cancellations and raised regional security risks.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 胡塞武装对沙特民用航空和首都的袭击可能加剧也门战争外溢，并威胁海湾航运与能源安全。
items.why_it_matters_en: Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and Riyadh could worsen the Yemen war’s spillover and threaten Gulf shipping and energy security.

items.title: 星巴克研究收购奇波雷墨西哥烧烤的可能性
items.summary_zh: 咖啡连锁巨头星巴克正研究收购市值近390亿美元的奇波雷墨西哥烧烤。若交易达成，将成为餐饮业有史以来规模最大的并购交易。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该潜在并购将重塑全球餐饮行业格局，并考验监管机构对大型消费品牌整合的态度。

items.title: 英伟达启动1500亿美元股票回购计划
items.summary_zh: 英伟达启动1500亿美元股票回购，为美国企业史上规模最大的回购计划。该公司继续凭借在AI供应链顶端的优势地位赚取巨额利润。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 巨额回购显示AI芯片龙头现金流强劲，也可能影响市场对AI资本开支周期和科技股估值的看法。

items.title: 谷歌将智能体AI引入Gemini，率先面向企业用户
items.original_title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.summary_zh: 谷歌将Gemini升级为可规划、执行任务并跨业务应用与系统工作的AI智能体。该智能体可委派子代理、使用多种AI模型，并拥有自己的工作身份和邮箱地址。
items.summary_en: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate to subagents, use multiple AI models, and gets its own workplace identity and email address.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 企业级智能体竞争升温，谷歌此举可能推动AI从聊天工具向可执行工作流的平台转变。
items.why_it_matters_en: The move intensifies competition in enterprise AI agents and could accelerate the shift from chatbots to task-executing workflows.

items.title: 德国阻止中资收购汉堡港物流企业
items.summary_zh: 德国否决中远海运收购康拉德•齐佩尔货运代理80%股份。上届德国政府曾批准中远海运入股汉堡港一集装箱码头，此次决定显示对中资进入关键物流基础设施的审查趋严。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映欧洲对中资参与港口与物流基础设施的安全审查正在加强，可能影响中企在欧洲的并购路径。

items.title: 中国Manus与Meta分拆后首轮融资超5亿美元
items.original_title: China’s Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
items.summary_zh: 中国AI公司Manus在脱离Meta后完成首轮融资，募资超过5亿美元。博裕资本和IDG资本领投，腾讯、HSG、真格基金等现有股东参投。
items.summary_en: China’s Manus raised over $500 million in its first funding round since splitting with Meta. Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the round, with existing shareholders Tencent, HSG, ZhenFund, and others participating.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大额融资显示中国AI初创企业在全球资本寒冬中仍具吸引力，也反映其与大型平台分拆后的独立发展路径。
items.why_it_matters_en: The large round shows Chinese AI startups can still attract major capital and highlights Manus’s independent path after splitting from Meta.

items.title: 中国吉利汽车发布充电时间不到5分钟电池
items.summary_zh: 吉利称其超快充系统仅需4分30秒即可将电池电量从10%充至70%。此举凸显中国车企为降低成本而寻求减少对宁德时代电池的依赖。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超快充技术竞争加剧，可能改变电动车供应链格局并推动中国车企进一步拓展海外市场。

items.title: 韩国因战俘争议召回驻乌克兰大使
items.original_title: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over prisoner-of-war row
items.summary_zh: 在乌克兰披露两名朝鲜战俘被转移至首尔后，韩国召回驻乌克兰大使。这是双方围绕战俘问题的最新外交摩擦。
items.summary_en: South Korea recalled its envoy from Ukraine after Kyiv disclosed that two North Korean prisoners of war were transferred to Seoul. It is the latest diplomatic spat over the POW issue.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 事件涉及朝鲜、乌克兰与韩国三方关系，可能影响韩国对乌援助及对朝情报合作。
items.why_it_matters_en: The dispute involves North Korea, Ukraine, and South Korea and could affect Seoul’s aid to Kyiv and intelligence cooperation on Pyongyang.

items.title: 意大利批准选举制度改革，反对派指责梅洛尼“骗局”
items.original_title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
items.summary_zh: 意大利批准选举制度改革，总理梅洛尼称此举将带来更稳定的政府。反对党指责其真实目的是继续掌权。
items.summary_en: Italy approved an overhaul of its election system. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says it will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 选举规则变化可能影响意大利未来政治格局，并成为欧洲右翼政府巩固权力的又一案例。
items.why_it_matters_en: The electoral change could reshape Italian politics and becomes another example of a European right-wing government consolidating power.

items.title: 印度3年来首次加息
items.summary_zh: 印度央行货币政策委员会一致决定加息0.25点至5.5%，为三年来首次加息。理由包括通胀加速、全球能源价格上涨以及印度经济增长强劲。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 印度央行转向加息可能影响新兴市场资本流动和全球通胀预期。

items.title: 《今日美国》成为最新起诉OpenAI的出版商
items.original_title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 《今日美国》及其旗下多家地方报纸起诉OpenAI，指其未经授权复制“数十万篇”文章用于训练AI模型，并索赔超过2.5亿美元。OpenAI尚未在报道中作出回应。
items.summary_en: USA Today Co. and several local newspapers it owns are suing OpenAI, alleging it copied hundreds of thousands of articles to train its AI models. The publisher seeks more than $250 million in damages.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 版权诉讼持续增加，可能推高AI公司训练数据的法律成本并改变内容授权模式。
items.why_it_matters_en: The growing copyright litigation could raise legal costs for AI training data and reshape content licensing deals.

items.title: 被解雇的OpenAI安全研究员否认行为不当，警告寒蝉效应
items.original_title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
items.summary_zh: 三名被解雇的OpenAI安全研究员否认不当处理敏感信息的指控，并在公开信中警告，他们的解雇正在对公司AI安全文化产生寒蝉效应。
items.summary_en: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information and warn in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 此事关系OpenAI内部安全治理与员工能否自由提出风险警告，可能影响公众对前沿AI安全承诺的信任。
items.why_it_matters_en: The dispute concerns OpenAI’s internal safety governance and whether employees can raise risk warnings, affecting trust in frontier AI safety commitments.

items.title: 清华具身模型登顶全球第一，突围GPT-6与英伟达
items.summary_zh: 量子位报道，清华团队具身模型登顶全球第一，突围GPT-6和英伟达，且不依赖外挂和额外数据。其思路是将视频预测与动作学习分阶段训练，重点在于解耦并重新排序，而非“视频、动作一锅炖”。目前信息有限，具体评测细节待核实。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 具身智能是AI与机器人结合的关键方向，该成果显示中国团队在无需额外数据的情况下取得领先，可能推动机器人学习范式变化。

items.title: Anthropic为开源项目推出免费AI安全扫描
items.original_title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
items.summary_zh: Anthropic推出名为OSS Scanner的新服务，为选择加入的开源项目提供“由最强模型进行的全面定期安全扫描”，且不收费。这可能让开源项目更早发现安全问题，但报道指出也存在权衡。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, offering opt-in open-source projects “thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost.” The service could alert projects to security issues sooner, though the report notes trade-offs.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源软件是数字基础设施的关键环节，AI驱动的免费安全扫描可能提升整体供应链安全，但也引发模型访问与数据使用边界问题。
items.why_it_matters_en: Open-source software is critical digital infrastructure, so AI-driven free security scans could improve supply-chain security while raising questions about model access and data boundaries.

items.title: Goodfire称其“由内而外”监控器能以极低成本捕捉失控AI智能体
items.original_title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
items.summary_zh: Goodfire推出一种更便宜的AI智能体监控方式：不另付费用让第二个AI阅读智能体所有行为，而是在模型工作时窥探内部，只在发现可疑情况时调用备份。
items.summary_en: Goodfire launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI智能体进入企业流程，低成本、可扩展的行为监控成为安全落地的关键。
items.why_it_matters_en: As AI agents enter enterprise workflows, low-cost, scalable behavior monitoring becomes key to safe deployment.

items.title: 联合国警告用于读取公民思想的技术
items.original_title: U.N. Warns Against Technology Used to Read Citizens’ Minds
items.summary_zh: 联合国秘书长在一份报告中警告，新技术可能被用于获取并刑事化人们最内心的想法。报道未说明具体技术细节或涉及国家。
items.summary_en: A report by the U.N. secretary-general warns that new technologies could be used to access and criminalize people’s innermost thoughts. The report did not specify the technologies or countries involved.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该警告将神经技术与隐私、人权和国家安全监管推到国际议程，可能推动新的治理规则。
items.why_it_matters_en: The warning puts neurotechnology, privacy, human rights, and national security regulation on the international agenda and may spur new governance rules.

items.title: 大众就汽车融资丑闻拨备7.25亿英镑
items.summary_zh: 大众为汽车融资丑闻拨备7.25亿英镑。该丑闻源于汽车经销商在协助购车者办理贷款时，未充分披露自己将获得的佣金，整个汽车行业因此遭受的冲击已超过15亿英镑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 融资佣金披露问题可能引发更广泛的行业合规与赔偿压力，影响汽车金融业务模式。
